items.title: Succinct generators for SL tensor actions would collapse VP and VNP through hyperpfaffian completeness
items.author: Ankit Garg; Christian Ikenmeyer; Visu Makam; Rafael Oliveira; Michael Walter; Avi Wigderson
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete17-page six-author CC BY3.0 Unported publication; mainTheorem11 and complete formalSection4 hyperpfaffian proof, with source-local Section3 deduction context. Nativev2 private aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors identify the essential lowest-degree invariant through Schur-Weyl decomposition, prove that its hyperpfaffian evaluation realizes a permanent projection by tracking block-permutation signs, and use this unavoidable generator to transfer succinct-encoding existence to a VP/VNP collapse.
